name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: Session 333 restored The Desk to live publishing after a six-day, nine-run outage, and it took two independent fixes stacked in sequence. Topic selection gave up after one topic whose only direct source answered 401 while six readable topics sat untried; that repair then exposed a second failure it had been masking, where the managed inference provider had retired the pinned authoring model while still advertising it. The session also wired a regression self-test that had never been invoked by any runner into build:check, generalized its single-script assertion into a structural invocation-mode detector, repaired a public forge ledger that was publishing zero entries because a fixed 120-commit scan window had been buried by automation churn, and added consecutive-unknown streak plus last-known-good age to canonical destination evidence.
publicNote: The newsroom is publishing again after six quiet days. It had been giving up after the first story it could not read instead of trying the next one, and once that was fixed it turned out the writing service had also quietly dropped the model it was using. Both are fixed, and the site now shows how long a product link has been unverifiable and when it last definitely worked, without ever calling an unverifiable link broken.
nextMilestone: Confirm unattended scheduled Desk runs keep landing editions, thread the authoring-model fallback into published story provenance, extend check-build-gate-reachability to every self-test-bearing module, and complete the founder-reserved Obelisk relying-party/passkey ceremony when available.
